projectDescription: An MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects AI agents to the Fenkit task management platform, enabling autonomous task discovery, planning, execution tracking, and structured documentation.
keyFeatures: One-command setup for 7 AI clients (Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity)
Three runtime modes: read-runtime, write-runtime, and admin for granular access control
Autonomous task lifecycle management: discovery, planning, execution, and walkthrough documentation
Chat-task binding for deterministic task context resolution across sessions
Idempotent write operations with optional preview/confirmation flow for sensitive changes
Automatic protocol injection into client rule files for consistent AI agent behavior
Compact and full task context retrieval to optimize LLM token usage
publicApiSurface: get_status — check auth and active project
list_tasks — list tasks with optional status filter
get_task_context_full — full task details including plan and walkthrough
get_task_section — retrieve a specific section of task context
resolve_chat_task — resolve chat-to-task binding by chat_id
setup_client — configure an AI client to use Fenkit MCP
get_setup_instructions — retrieve manual config snippets without writing files
